title: University enrollment certificate
short_description: Registrar office issues an enrollment certificate after verifying the student record.

title: IT password reset fulfillment
short_description: IT support verifies identity, resets a password, and resolves the ticket.

title: Outpatient appointment check-in
short_description: Clinic reception checks in a patient for a scheduled appointment.

title: Insurance claim triage
short_description: A claims handler routes a home damage claim to rejection, fast-track approval, or detailed assessment.

title: Travel reimbursement approval
short_description: Finance reviews a reimbursement request and either returns it, auto-approves it, or escalates it for manager approval.

title: Bank card application outcome
short_description: A bank processes a credit card application with direct approval, manual review, or rejection outcomes.

title: Employee onboarding setup
short_description: HR operations launches onboarding activities in parallel before sending the welcome package.

title: Procurement request fulfillment
short_description: Procurement reserves budget, creates the purchase order, and alerts the warehouse in parallel.

title: Applicant and HR interview scheduling
short_description: An applicant and recruiter exchange messages until an interview slot is confirmed.

title: Supplier and buyer purchase confirmation
short_description: A supplier and buyer negotiate availability and confirm or reject a purchase order.

title: Public grant application review
short_description: A grant officer reviews forms and supporting files, records the case, and produces an evaluation report.

title: Hospital billing adjustment
short_description: Hospital billing reviews disputed charges and either explains the bill or issues a corrected invoice.

title: Support ticket SLA breach
short_description: An IT support ticket is either resolved in time or escalated when the SLA deadline is reached.

title: Travel booking payment timeout
short_description: A traveler either pays before the deadline and receives a ticket or misses the deadline and receives a cancellation.

title: Software procurement stress test
short_description: A cross-functional software procurement process combines approvals, supplier communication, parallel reviews, data artifacts, and deadline-driven exceptions.
